name: ai-mode-workspace
description: A native macOS shell around Google AI Mode

scripts.gen:icons: cd packages/desktop && bunx tauri icon ../../public/logo/logo-mac.png -o src-tauri/icons
scripts.build:desktop: bun run gen:icons && bun run --filter ai-mode build
scripts.build:mac: bun run --filter ai-mode build && bun run install:mac
